column3: Settled midfield - pressed for effort and moved through to hit the front inside the final furlong - stayed on well to score
Slow to settle at back of field - made progress 2f out - driven out and kept going from final furlong to just fail by a short head margin
Held up towards back of field - improved into contention 2f out - pushed along and finished strongly from inside final furlong - just held for third by three-quarters of a length
Sat close to the front early - went clear 3f out then lost the advantage inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish fourth
Settled at the back of the field - pushed along and made progress 2f out - stayed on late without threatening the front runners
Settled towards rear of the pack - never truly involved - finished sixth beaten 3¾l
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - unable to close on the front-runners - finished seventh beaten 4.5 lengths
Held a midfield berth - pushed along with two furlongs left - unable to land a blow on the front group - finished eighth beaten just under five lengths
Settled off the pace - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost ground inside final furlong to finish ninth
Settled off the pace - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 10th
Went straight to the front - pressed for effort then lost command 3f out - dropped away rapidly and finished well behind
Settled towards back early - pushed along with 2f left then progressed inside final 2f - powered clear close home to score
Settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - finished fast through the closing stages to just miss out
Settled towards the back - closed strongly with 2f left and pushed along - hit the front inside the last furlong before losing out close home
Settled midpack early - pushed along over 2f from home before surging to the front approaching the final furlong - overtaken soon after - lost momentum inside the closing stages to finish 4th
Settled midfield - pressed for effort with 2f left - finished with steady late progress but held to fifth
Settled towards the back - pushed along and stayed on without gaining ground inside final furlong - finished sixth beaten 3.75 lengths
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - moved into contention keenly by halfway - pushed along to reach the front group 2f out then unable to find more approaching the final furlong
Settled around midpack early - pushed along with 2f left - drifted left and dropped away inside the final furlong - finished eighth beaten 5 lengths
Tracked the front group wide of rivals - hit the front with 2f left - pushed along and faded inside the last furlong to finish ninth
Settled off the pace early - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong - eventually well beaten in 10th
Tracked the pace early - hit the front approaching halfway before losing command 2f out - pushed along but faded from there
Sent forward to front after 1f - lost command past 5f and sat behind pace-setter - urged along and dropped away rapidly with 2f left
Settled off the pace early - improved on outer turning in - bumped lightly in 6th spot 1½f out - pushed along to stay on and got up in the closing strides

Settled midfield early - up to 5th with 4f remaining - driven and eased over to the right approaching the last furlong and a half - responded to urging to close strongly late but denied by a short margin
Quick start and sat handy travelling keenly - 5th at halfway - slipped back through the pack 4f out - 7th and driven approaching the final furlong - responded strongly late to snatch 3rd close home

Held a midfield spot early - 4th at halfway - driven forward to move through the field inside the final two furlongs - nosed in front approaching the last 150 yards before being caught right at the line
Handy early and hit front after 3f - driven approaching straight and overtaken with 150 yards left - unable to fight back at the finish

Went straight to the front early - lost the advantage before 3f and settled third by halfway - boxed in for room around 1½f out then unable to close in fourth and ground on without gaining late finishing 6th
Sat close to the front pack early - disputed second at halfway - driven into the straight - held third and asked for effort a furlong out before finding little near the finish
Held up towards the back of the pack - asked for effort but made no headway into the straight - still 8th a furlong out and stayed on without gaining further ground
Held up at the back throughout - driven approaching the straight but couldn't respond - dropped away to finish well behind
Slow to break - soon in front - drifted right and lost command over a furlong out - rallied right to regain advantage inside final furlong and stayed on strongly for the win

Settled in rear early - shifted right approaching 3f out - made progress with 2f left - hit front a furlong out - drifted left near the finish and lost balance for a moment before being overtaken - kept on to go down narrowly
Shared front spot early - sat close up behind pace - urged forward with 2f left - couldn't find extra pace and stayed third to finish
Shared front-running spot early - tracking pace-setter and still handy when checked inside final furlong - unable to fight back and finished fourth
Handy in fourth as the field settled - pushed along with 4f left - found extra momentum 2f out - shaken up to get on terms a furlong out - hit the front 150 yards from home and kept going to win
Settled off the pace - 6th at halfway - pressed for effort with 4f left - couldn't close inside the final furlong - flew home late to snatch second on the line

Sat close to the front group in 4th - improved into 2nd approaching 3f out - closed on the pacesetter with 2f left - hit the front turning into the straight - edged clear a furlong out - quickly matched - overtaken 150 yards from home - battled on to be caught for 3rd right at the line

Settled at back early - moved into contention 4f out - up to third and pressing leaders entering straight - shared front spot inside final furlong before being passed 150 yards out - stayed on at the finish for 4th
Sat just behind the pack in 5th - improved to 4th approaching final two furlongs - pushed for the lead into the straight but squeezed for space with a furlong left - battled on to finish 5th
Settled towards the back - 7th at halfway and unable to close when asked before the straight - stayed on at one speed from the final furlong to finish sixth beaten 4.5 lengths
Travelled keenly early - tucked in behind pace - hit front after 4f - overtaken turning into straight - pressed for a spot in 3rd approaching final furlong then unable to find more - finished seventh
Set the pace for the opening stages - still in touch soon after - pushed along and slipped back with 3f left - trailing by 2f out - well held at the finish
Set the pace from the break - pushed along with two furlongs left - stayed on strongly to score
Settled at the rear early - driven up into contention inside the final furlong to move into second - edged out late for the runner-up spot
Settled in behind the pace - pushed along with two furlongs left - closed steadily inside the final furlong - fought for the runner-up spot but narrowly missed out in third

Held up in the pack early - improved into third with 3f left - pushed into the lead spot approaching 2f out then edged into second inside the final furlong and a half - handed that spot back and held late finishing fourth
Tracked the pace early - dropped back approaching 3f out then pushed along - unable to respond and beaten into fifth
Wide early on - stayed handy before pushed along 2f out - lost ground final furlong to finish sixth
Settled behind pace - pushed to front inside final furlong - kept finding more to the line
Settled at the back showing eagerness early - pressed forward and pushed along a furlong out - finished strongly through the last furlong - denied by three quarters of a length
Settled towards the back - pressed for effort 2f out and boxed in briefly - found room left before finishing well to take third
Went straight to front early - pushed along approaching final quarter mile before being overtaken - held on for fourth without finding more late
Sat close to pace early - pushed along with 2f left - unable to quicken final furlong finishing 5th beaten 4.5 lengths
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - lost ground inside final furlong - finished sixth
Sluggish start - held towards back - pushed along with 2f left but couldn't get involved
Settled off the pace - pushed along with 2f left - lost ground final furlong - finished eighth
Held a midpack position early - pushed along and dropped away 2f out - finished ninth well beaten
Settled midfield early - moved through into 4th turning for home - driven to find a way through and hit the front inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to prevail by a whisker
Settled midpack early - moved up on the inner turning for home - boxed in around 5th with a furlong left - found a gap to challenge close home and edged into second at the line
Settled in the pack early - urged forward and made progress wide out approaching final two furlongs into 6th - finished strongly to snatch third near the line
Sat close to the pace early - fourth at halfway then pushed along and up to second inside final furlong but couldn't threaten - finished fourth beaten just under four lengths
Held up towards the back - made progress into straight but boxed in around 8th with a furlong left - eased right and finished strongly to be 5th
Sat close up early - third at halfway - driven forward to hit the front two out - soon collared and unable to find more - held on for sixth

Went straight to front early - driven to stay clear before edging in front by a nose 2f out - pressed for effort inside final furlong and unable to find more in the closing stages - finished seventh beaten 5.5 lengths
Sat close to the front group early - still 7th at halfway then asked for effort in the straight without gaining ground - stayed on at one speed late finishing eighth
Sluggish start settling near the back - pushed along with no headway a furlong and a half out - finished 9th staying on late inside the closing stages
Tardy away and at the back - made some late progress from inside the final furlong - no threat throughout to finish 10th
Held up towards the back - driven early in the straight without threatening leaders - stayed on steadily late but well held
Held up in the pack - driven approaching the straight but failed to close entering the final two furlongs - held towards the finish - eventually well beaten in 12th
Held up at the back - driven approaching the final furlong - stayed on same tempo out wide - well held in 13th
Held towards the back of the pack early - urged into action entering the straight with little response inside the final furlong - stayed on at one speed to finish 14th
Sent forward early - settled 5th of the pack by halfway then unable to make headway into the straight - held no threat under pressure in the final furlong to finish 15th
Tardy away and immediately well adrift - no involvement throughout - plugged on at the same tempo from beyond 1f out to finish 16th
Sat close to the front group early - 6th at halfway - driven early in the straight but couldn't gain ground and faded to finish 17th
Sat close to the pace early - second at halfway then driven and unable to find headway inside final two furlongs - faded to finish 18th beaten 11 lengths
Held up in the pack - pushed along entering the straight without threatening leaders - one-paced from over a furlong out - finished well held in 19th
Held up at the back - driven for effort with no gain nearing the straight - unable to quicken - eventually well held in 20th
Held up at the back - driven early in the straight with no headway - unable to find more late - finished well beaten
Settled midfield early - dropped away fast approaching 4f out to trail markedly - allowed to drop away in the straight and finished far adrift
Settled by the rail early - up with the pace - went to the front with 3f left - drew away inside the final furlong to hold on and win
Squeezed for space early - settled towards back - made progress on the far rail approaching 2f out - moved into second inside final furlong - stayed on but couldn't reach winner
Tracked the front group early - moved into second with 2f left - edged out late and unable to find more close home
Settled in the pack - improved into contention 3f out but drifted left approaching the final furlong - lost ground close home to finish fourth
Settled midfield early - lost touch with pace 3f out - dropped away inside final furlong to finish fifth
Held up towards the back - pressed for effort with 4f left - dropped away in the closing 2f - eventually home sixth
Pulled hard early - went clear in front - lost the advantage 3f out - dropped away final furlong

Settled off the pace - mid-pack around the sixth - made headway approaching the final two furlongs - into contention over the last - went ahead well inside the final furlong and asserted without being pressed late

Keen early - settled towards back - small error 3 out - made progress into third by 2 out - level with rivals approaching last - went in front early in straight - overtaken close home - kept responding to finish

Sat just behind the front group in 4th - lost ground briefly 4 out - up to 3rd 3 out - went in front before 2 out - challenged into the straight before being overhauled nearing the last - held station just off the front runner over the last - stayed on at an even effort to finish third

Sat close to the front pack - 6th on the far turn - clipped heels three out - moved up to second and pressed on before two out - drew alongside near the last - lost the advantage soon after with effort waning to finish fourth
Sat close up in 5th - pushed along four out and slipped to 6th with two to jump - unable to close before the last and held on for 5th
Sat close to the front pack in 3rd - dropped back approaching 3 out and down to 5th by 2 out - unable to respond before the last and well held
Went straight to front - overtaken 2nd then settled into second spot - regained command for a moment after 3 out - dropped to 4th with nothing left before fading out of contention
Went forward to lead after the second - overtaken approaching three out - began to slip back through the pack - down the order and trailing by two out - beaten off well before the finish
Settled just behind the pace - pushed along approaching the final furlong and moved into contention - took over close home - drew away to score
Sat handy behind the front group - pushed into the advantage a furlong out before being overtaken close home - stayed on for second
Settled in the pack - pushed along inside final furlong to move into third - kept on to finish third beaten 3½ lengths
Tracked the pace near the front - pushed along inside the final furlong - faded to finish fourth
Set the pace early - pressed for effort inside final two furlongs before being overtaken - dropped away in the closing stages - finished fifth
Settled at the rear - pushed along with 2f to run - showed nothing thereafter - well beaten in 6th
Sat close behind pace - driven approaching final 2f and stayed on hard - hit front with a furlong left and edged clear to win
Sat close to the front - shaken up to go clear inside final furlong before being reeled in - stayed on strongly to finish second
Settled midfield early - pushed along with two furlongs left and still in contention approaching the final furlong - stayed on at one speed to finish third
Tracked front pack - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on same speed inside final furlong - finished fourth beaten 3¼ lengths
Settled in the pack - pushed along over 2f out then edged closer to the front group inside the final furlong - lost ground quickly nearer the finish
Sluggish start - pushed along with 2f left then found some late progress - faded inside final furlong to finish sixth
Sluggish start - held towards back before pushed into contention 2f out - unable to quicken final furlong finishing 7th
Sluggish start - always down the field - finished 8th
Went straight to front setting a fast gallop - pushed along with 2f left - lost the advantage and dropped away rapidly with a furlong to run - finished well held in 9th
Held up towards back - never a factor - well held in 10th
Settled just behind the front group - mid-pack around halfway - made progress into the straight to loom up second with a furlong left - hit the front close home and stayed on strongly to score
Slow into stride and settled towards the back - roused into contention with a furlong left - finished strongly to snatch second on the line
Held a midfield spot wide of rivals - pushed along inside final two furlongs and up to 5th with a furlong left - finished strongly to grab third
Sat just behind the front group - 7th at halfway then asked for effort inside final two furlongs - finished strongly to close within a length in 4th

Set the pace early - sat in behind in third at halfway - asked for effort and made ground into the straight - regained command with a furlong and a half left - overtaken close home and could not respond
Held up at the back - pushed along wide with 2f left and 12th entering final furlong - finished strongly through the closing stages to take 6th
Held up towards the back - urged into effort entering the straight and 10th with a furlong left - finished strongly to be 7th beaten 2 lengths
Up with the pace before taking command after a furlong and a half - urged on straightening up then lost the advantage inside the last two furlongs - unable to find more late and finished eighth
Sat behind the front group early - up to 2nd by halfway - slipped to 3rd and driven into the straight - dropped to 4th under pressure a furlong out and found little more to finish 9th
Sprang awkwardly at the break - settled towards the back - urged forward but made no ground with 2f left - stayed on steadily late without threatening the front runners
Held up towards the back early - still in the second half of the field at halfway - urged for effort but made no headway into the straight - stayed on steadily late without threatening to finish 11th
Up with the front group - 4th at halfway - nudged forward inside 2f out - tight for room 1f out and faded to finish 12th
Sat behind the front group early - 6th at halfway - urged forward on the inner entering the straight but boxed in with a furlong left - couldn't find more and beaten into 13th
Settled in the pack early - driven for effort entering the straight without threatening the front - unable to find more late - finished well held in 14th
Settled in the middle of the field - off the bridle entering the straight and unable to land a blow inside the final furlong - faded into 15th
Held up towards the back - made no impression through the race - held towards finish - eventually well beaten in 16th
Held up towards the back - unable to make an impression - finished well held in 17th
Set the pace from the off - pushed along a furlong out - finished strongly to the line
Tracked the leader from the off - pressed for effort a furlong out but unable to close inside final stretch - stayed on to finish second beaten a length
Settled in the pack early pulling hard - found more with two furlongs left - pushed along a furlong out - outpaced by winner approaching final furlong - stayed on for third beaten a length and a half
Settled midpack early and fighting for control - pushed along with 2f remaining - stayed on without the speed to challenge over 1f out then finished fourth beaten 2¼ lengths
Sluggish start - held towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - eased across to the left approaching the final furlong - unable to threaten the front and finished 5th beaten 3.75 lengths
Settled handy on the outer - pushed along with two to go and drifted left approaching the furlong marker - lost ground through the closing stages to finish sixth
Held up in last place - out of contention in the closing 2f
Keen to go forward early - hit front after the opening fence - drifted left approaching the straight - kept finding more to score

Settled in 4th at a steady tempo - improved 4 out and pulled away from the back group - moved up to 2nd and launched a bid 2 out - brushed entering the straight - kept on gamely on the run-in to finish second beaten 1¼ lengths
Sat close to the front pair - held a handy third before shortening the gap approaching 4 out - pushed along 2 out but unable to make further headway - held same position to the last

Set the pace early - handed up spot behind rival after being passed - well ahead of others down the field until 4 out - pushed along before 2 out - dropped back soon after - held 4th with nothing more left approaching last
Settled in midfield early - blundered 4 out with nothing to offer - lost touch before 3 out - well held at the finish
Held up at rear from the off - no impression on the front group - eased and pulled up before 4 out
Held up at the rear from the start - never a factor - eased and pulled up before 4 out
Settled in third early - pushed to the front inside the final furlong - held the challenge to prevail
Settled in second early - roused to hit front approaching final furlong - overtaken soon after and fought back in closing stages - narrowly denied at the line
Set the pace early - pressed for effort and lost front spot inside final two furlongs - dropped away in the closing stages to finish third
Hesitant start - settled at the back - made ground into contention past the 2f marker - asked for effort - hit the front inside the final furlong and kept on to win
Settled midfield early - travelling strongly into the final 3f and pushed to the front approaching the last furlong - overtaken soon after and battled on to finish second
Tracked the pace-setter - pushed along with two furlongs left - lost ground inside the last
Sat close to the front group under pressure - eased across to the far rail approaching 2f out - stayed on at one speed inside final furlong to finish fourth
Went straight to front - pressed for effort with over 2f remaining - lost command approaching final furlong and could not respond - finished 5th
Settled towards the back early - pushed along with 3f left - dropped away 2f out - eventually finished sixth
Settled around midfield - pressed for effort with 3f left - dropped away 2f out - finished well held in 7th
Sluggish start - fought bridle early - pressed for effort and dropped away 3f out - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack early - fifth at the halfway stage - urged forward to gain ground two out and up to third with a furlong left - driven out to get up right at the finish
Settled midpack early - fourth at the midway point - urged forward turning for home - into second and driven a furlong out - fought for the front nearing the line before edged out right at the finish
Set the pace from the off - held a narrow margin at halfway then stretched clear approaching 2f out - driven inside the final furlong and battled on - caught late to finish third
Sat just off the pacesetter - second at halfway then pressed for effort 2f out and slipped to 4th inside the final furlong - stayed on at one speed to finish 4th
Held up towards the back - urged into contention entering the straight - up to 5th - one-paced through the final furlong to finish 5th
Held up towards the back throughout - made no headway turning for home - stayed on same speed inside the final furlong to finish sixth
Sat close to pace early - third at halfway - driven and dropped back soon after turning in then faded near the furlong marker
Set the pace from the outset - moved over to the far rail on own terms early - pushed along inside final furlong - opened a decisive advantage close home to score comfortably
Sluggish start - settled among midfield group - made ground into contention around 2f out - pressed for the lead a furlong out but couldn't close the gap late
Squeezed for space at the break - settled handy through the middle stages - angling through to chase leaders inside the final furlong - unable to challenge the winner but stayed on for third
Held a forward spot through the middle - lost momentum a furlong out - rallied in the closing stages to chase the minor placing
Held up towards back of mid-group - angled right approaching final 2f - driven along and closed slightly inside final furlong but always held
Drifted left from the stalls - went forward to set the pace through the middle of the track - pressed for effort a furlong out - lost place approaching the final furlong to finish sixth
Drifted right at the break - settled among midfield in the middle - lost ground under a furlong out and unable to threaten
Up with the front group - 4th jumping 4 out - hit the front after 3 out - 3 lengths to the good over the last - kept on strongly before being allowed to coast home
Sat close behind the front group early - fifth with four to jump - moved into second two out - couldn't close before the last but kept going to finish second
Held up towards the back - nudged into contention 4 out - 10th at the second-last - 7th and outpaced approaching the finish - kept going to nab 3rd in the closing strides
Sat close to the pace in 2nd - dropped back 3 out - down to 4th with two to jump - kept on without threatening late
Held up towards the back - nudged into contention 3 out - 7th at the second last - still 6th and unable to threaten leaders into the last then finished on one level
Held a midfield berth early - dropped towards the back 4 out before making headway to close in by 3 out - up into 5th 2 out - couldn't get closer approaching the last - finished steadily for 6th
Held up at the back - edged closer before two out but made no headway near the finish - stayed on at one speed to finish 7th
Settled in the pack early - still down in 8th four out - made ground into third by two out - unable to threaten leaders and weakened before the last
Sat close behind the front group early - up in third 4 out before dropping back nearing 2 out - unable to make further headway to finish ninth beaten just over 11 lengths
Held up towards the back - made no headway before two out - well beaten in the closing stages
Sat close to the pace - minor error 4th - dropped to 6th 4 out then faded 3 out - unable to threaten home turned 11th
Held up towards the back - couldn't find any headway approaching 2 out - well held through to the line
Held up towards the back of the pack - nudged into contention 4 out - ninth two out but unable to threaten leaders late
Settled in the pack - 7th four out before slipping backward approaching three out - dropped away before two out to finish well beaten
Settled midfield - minor error 4 out then dropped away from 3 out - beaten well before the finish
Set the pace early - overtaken after 3 out and dropped away quickly - faded further 2 out - well held at the finish

Settled at the rear early - looked unfurnished passing the 3f marker - urged forward with 2f to go - edged off a straight line but gained ground fast approaching the final furlong - shaken up to get in front close home - held on under pressure through the last 150yds - prevailed by the narrowest of margins

Sat behind the pace early - closed on the front-runner approaching 2f out - shoved into the advantage inside the final 2f - challenged and put back in second early in the last furlong - fought back inside the final 150yds - narrowly denied at the line
Sat third early - urged forward 3f out and made smooth progress 2f out - squeezed for space and dropped a spot inside final 2f - stayed on to finish third
Set the pace early - urged on approaching the 3f marker then driven with two out - overtaken inside the final furlong and squeezed for space as strength ebbed - finished fourth beaten 2½ lengths
Settled towards back early - pushed along with 2f left - surged home over 1f out and hit front close home to score
Tracked the pace - pushed along over 2f out and hit front before the final furlong - overtaken close home to finish second
Held a midpack position early - pushed along and made progress over 2f out - kept going from the final furlong to finish third
Tracked the pace - pushed along with 2f left and drifted left approaching the furlong pole - stayed on to finish fourth
Held up towards the back and pulling hard - pressed for effort 2f out - stayed on at one speed inside final furlong to finish 5th
Settled off the pace early - pushed along with 2f left and closed into contention approaching final furlong - unable to find more late and finished sixth
Went straight to front - pushed along with 2f remaining - lost the advantage and faded inside the final furlong - eventually finished seventh
Sluggish start and eased back towards the tail - pushed along with 2f left - not landing a blow - finished eighth beaten 8 lengths
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 9th
Sluggish to break - stayed towards the back through the race - well held at the finish
Held up at the back throughout - never got competitive - finished well held in 11th
Sat behind the front pack - third at halfway - asked for effort inside final 2f to move into second - hit the front close to the line and stayed on strongly
Settled midfield early - 4th at halfway - asked for effort entering the straight and pressed on inside final furlong - finished strongly to snatch second close home
Set the pace early - opened a big advantage by the midpoint - pressed for effort inside the final two furlongs and overtaken close to home holding no more in reserve
Sat close to the front early - disputed 2nd at halfway - asked for effort into the straight - dropped to 3rd with a furlong left then edged back to finish 4th holding on late

Held up at back of the pack - still 5th at halfway and asked for effort into the straight with little response 2f out - dropped to 6th and driven a furlong out - finished strongly inside the final 150 yards
Held up towards the back - driven into contention around 2f out to sit 5th with a furlong left - held no more late
Held up at the back early - urged into effort entering the straight - 7th and outpaced with a furlong left - stayed on at one speed to the line without threatening
Settled in the pack early - held 6th at halfway - asked for effort entering straight but made no headway - eased back through the field inside final furlong and held on for eighth
Set the pace from the start - driven and drifted left inside final furlong - drew away in the closing stages to hold on well
Sat behind leader - driven and eased across two out then squeezed for room approaching final furlong - unable to close final stretch finishing second beaten 3 lengths
Up with the front group - dropped away 2f out - a long way adrift entering the final furlong
Ducked right at the off - unseated rider
Sat close to pace early - moved to front before 2 out and held a length turning for home - kept finding to the line
Sat close up in 3rd - moved into 2nd before 2 out but found little near line - kept on to finish second
Sat handy in 4th early - made progress 3 out and pressed on before 2 out - up to 3rd approaching last - unable to find more - stayed on at one speed to finish third
Sat just behind the front group in 5th - made headway approaching 2 out and up to 4th before the last - couldn't find more after that and stayed there
Went straight to the front - overtaken nearing two out and dropped away quickly - faded before the final fence - well held at the finish

Settled behind the front group - lost ground for a spell over 2f out - moved left and closed strongly a furlong out - pushed to draw level inside the final furlong - hit the front 75yds out and stayed on strongly to score
Set the pace early - urged on with two furlongs left - driven out inside the final furlong - couldn't find more and lost front spot close to the line
Settled handy in the early running - urged forward with two furlongs left - lost touch with the pace a furlong out - stayed on gamely inside the final furlong to finish third
Tracked leading group early - pushed for effort with over 2f left but couldn't threaten - dropped away inside final furlong
Settled in the pack early - driven for effort with 2f left - held no threat to the front group and faded to finish fifth beaten 9 lengths
Sluggish and drifted off a straight line at the off - held up at the rear throughout - never landed a blow - well held in 6th
Handy early - pressed for effort then lost ground from 2f out - finished well held in 7th
Slow to muster pace from the off - held up towards the back - never troubled the front rank - well held at the finish in 8th
Held up in the pack early - urged forward with 2f to run - dropped away under pressure inside the final furlong - finished ninth well beaten
Settled towards back early - pushed along with 2f left before moving through to hit front inside final furlong - kept finding more to the line
Sluggish start - settled near back - pushed along with two furlongs left - closed to dispute the lead approaching final furlong then stayed on to finish second
Handy early - hit front before 2f gone - pressed on approaching 2f out - lost advantage inside final furlong and unable to quicken finished third
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - made progress into the pack over 4f out - pushed along 2f out and stayed on at one speed late to finish 4th
Settled in the pack - nudged along and made a short-lived move approaching the final furlong - flattened out and finished fifth
Set the pace briefly before slipping back through the pack - pushed along to close on the front group 3f out - lost momentum inside the final furlong to finish sixth
Sat close to front pack early - pressed for effort with 2f remaining - dropped away rapidly soon after - finished well held in 7th
Race in a handy spot early - pressed the pace-setter from the 1f point then asked for effort with 3f left - lost ground fast and was eased out of contention 2f out
Sat close to the front pair - driven approaching final furlong then went ahead and drifted left - held on well to score
Set the pace early - pushed along a furlong out then overtaken in the closing stages - stayed on to finish second beaten a length and a half
Held eagerly early up with the pack - pushed along two furlongs out - moved into third in the closing stages but lacked the speed to get involved - finished well held in third
Settled in the pack early - nudged for effort with two furlongs left - unable to gain real headway - finished fourth beaten 5 lengths
Handy early - driven to challenge in front approaching 2f out - lost ground final furlong - finished fifth
Settled in behind leaders early - pressed for progress inside final 2f - unable to land a blow through to the line - finished 6th
Sat handy behind the front group - 4th and driven out entering the straight - hit the front a furlong out - stayed on strongly to win
Sat close to the front group - third at halfway - driven into the straight - stayed on for second late but couldn't threaten winner
Set the pace and opened a small advantage turning into the straight - pressed for effort and overtaken a furlong out - held for third late without threatening to rally
